cache_scope_contract.dynamic_repository_context: A consumer that reads repository state outside the frozen payload has an open dependency closure and cannot reuse a prior verdict from this benchmark.
required_for_verdict_reuse: identical reviewer implementation and model version

decision_contract.blocked: A complete bounded review input could not be produced. The downstream review must not be skipped.
decision_contract.full: No current review input was removed. The full current PR delta and every additional unresolved obligation are emitted.
decision_contract.residue: A complete accounting exists, the emitted current-change review input is a strict non-empty subset of the full current PR input, and every separately enumerated retired or base-drift obligation is also emitted.
decision_contract.skip: A complete accounting exists, the independent policy oracle has no needs-review or unresolved obligation inside the declared frozen input closure, and the emitted review input is empty. This is not an approval, a semantic-safety verdict, or permission to reuse a context-dependent model verdict.

materialization_contract.provider_same_base_fast_path: allowed only when both Q...B and Q...D comparisons are ahead or identical and both provider merge bases equal Q

required_snapshot_roles.A: the unique full-history merge-base of Q and B
required_snapshot_roles.C: the unique full-history merge-base of Q and D
required_snapshot_roles.D: the frozen final PR head commit
required_snapshot_roles.Q: the exact requested base commit frozen by the materialization manifest

materialization_contract.source_closure: Every commit, tree, and blob needed for A..B, C..D, carried predicates, retired-change reconstruction, and displayed evidence must be available with all remotes removed.

measurement_contract.aggregation: Publish case rows, ratio-of-sums for count and byte metrics, and median plus p95 for distributions. Never average per-case percentages without also publishing their denominators.
measurement_contract.bandwidth: Measure actual received wire bytes separately for provider API and Git transfer. Object-store or pack size may be reported as storage, but must not be relabeled as bandwidth.
measurement_contract.latency: Use a monotonic clock and report provider metadata, Git materialization, offline analysis, and Workbench readiness separately. Include timeouts and failures in the attempt table.
measurement_contract.line_counts: Use Git numstat additions plus deletions for text files. Report binary and unavailable files separately rather than assigning them zero lines.
measurement_contract.token_counts: Count the exact canonical downstream-review payload with a pinned tokenizer name, version, vocabulary digest, and serialization schema. Omit token savings when any of those bindings is absent.

acquisition_unavailable_rate.numerator: selected cases whose exact required public Git objects cannot be materialized

ancestry_materialization_failure_rate.denominator: selected cases routed to full-history ancestry verification
ancestry_materialization_failure_rate.numerator: those cases for which the exact required ancestry cannot be fetched or does not yield exactly one A and one C merge base

false_carry.denominator: all independently derived current-change identities and unresolved obligations in evaluated cases
false_carry.numerator: oracle needs-review identities or unresolved obligations that the product carries or omits from its emitted review input

false_skip.numerator: product skip decisions for which the oracle contains any needs-review identity, identity omission, unresolved retired change, unresolved base-drift obligation, or undeclared input dependency
false_skip.scope: verified review-input routing only; verdict reuse is outside this protocol

product_block_rate.denominator: cases with valid provenance and complete offline source closure for which the product was invoked
product_block_rate.numerator: those invocations returning blocked or failing to return a valid complete result

route_distribution.rule: The route is fixed from provider evidence before Git materialization or product execution and cannot depend on an observed product outcome.

token_savings.what_it_supports: input-token reduction only, not avoided inference cost or reusable model judgment

reproducibility_gate.required_result: Two clean offline runs over the same materialization produce byte-identical oracle and normalized product-result artifacts.
